About the research programme

Born–Hopf Geometry

A geometry-first mathematical physics programme by Peter Kugelmann, examining whether intrinsic finite constructions can explain measurable physical structure.

What this website is for

The site provides a readable account, the exact manuscripts and source code, original proof-chain audits, the current dependency atlas, and an explicit record of what remains conditional. The entry pages are summaries; they never replace mathematical hypotheses in the papers.

Current release

PapersMinimal v3.077; ProofChainAudits v1.83; DAG Atlas v1.223; geometry network v1.49. Public site package Paper00-GitHubPage-v1_2.

Using and citing the work

Use the exact paper and released version when citing a mathematical result, and check any source-specific conditions in the proof-chain report. Citation metadata is provided in the repository CITATION.cff. No reuse licence is implied unless a separate licence is published.
